maria (Docs): Quick sync 9 PR needs micro-edits: add resume-token TTL, jittered retry examples, and a tiny fallback to polling pages. Can SDK folks patch py/ts/go snippets?

sam (SDK): I can coordinate. Keep snippets very short (<=7 lines). Add a one-line note about batch_size tradeoffs.

eli (PY SDK): Pushed a compact python example to branch docs/stream-handoff: ```py
# jittered retry + resume token save
retry = Retry(jitter=True, base=0.1, max=1.5)
for ch in client.stream(req, retry=retry):
  if getattr(ch, 'resume_token', None): save(ch.resume_token)
  print(ch.text)
```

linda (TS SDK): TS async-iterator example submitted. Typing note included: resumeToken: string | undefined. ```ts
for await (const p of client.stream(req)) { if (p.resumeToken) store(p.resumeToken); console.log(p.text) }
```

jon (Go eng): Added a minimal Go pattern with context cancel + reconnect hint: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for c := range stream.Chunks() { fmt.Println(c.Text) }
// use exp backoff + jitter when reconnecting
```

maria (Docs): Two editorial asks: 1) add this exact sentence: "Resume tokens expire after 24 hours; persist tokens if you may resume." 2) add a 2-3 line fallback pseudocode for polling pages: ```pseudo
while has_more: page = client.list_pages(cursor); process(page); cursor = page.next_cursor
```

sam (SDK): Will update snippets and docs references. Will ping when preview is up.
